description: Minify an SVG and encode it as a compact percent-encoded (or base64) data URI, with background-image and mask-image CSS. Operations: "encode" — Optimise an SVG and return url-encoded and base64 data URIs, sizes and CSS snippets.; "decode" — Decode a data:image/svg+xml URI (percent-encoded or base64) back to SVG markup.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: encode: SVG markup. decode: A data URI, optionally wrapped in url("…").

operation.description: encode — Optimise an SVG and return url-encoded and base64 data URIs, sizes and CSS snippets. decode — Decode a data:image/svg+xml URI (percent-encoded or base64) back to SVG markup.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

shortenColors.description: Rewrite hex colours to their shortest form (#ff0000 → red). Used by: encode.

name: svg-data-uri
title: SVG to Data URI
